choose.when: SELECT p.id, NULLIF(TRIM(p.code), '') AS object_code, NULLIF(TRIM(p.task_code), '') AS task_code, NULLIF(TRIM(p.workshop_code), '') AS workshop_code, NULLIF(TRIM(p.route_code), '') AS route_code, p.source_route_node_code AS route_node_code, p.status, p.planned_end_time, p.start_time, p.finish_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mom_mes.mes_produce_task d WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(d.code), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(p.code), '') AND d.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND d.factory_code = #{factory} AND d.del_flag = '0') AS code_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mom_mes.mes_task t WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(t.code), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(p.task_code), '') AND t.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND t.factory_code = #{factory} AND t.del_flag = '0') AS parent_count FROM mom_mes.mes_produce_task p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND p.factory_code = #{factory} AND p.del_flag = '0' AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.task_code), '') = #{q.taskCode} AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.route_code), '') = #{q.routeCode}
choose.otherwise: SELECT t.id, NULLIF(TRIM(t.code), '') AS object_code, NULLIF(TRIM(t.code), '') AS task_code, NULLIF(TRIM(t.workshop_code), '') AS workshop_code, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS route_code, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR) AS route_node_code, t.status, t.plan_end_date AS planned_end_time, t.start_time, t.finish_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mom_mes.mes_task d WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(d.code), '') = NULLIF(TRIM(t.code), '') AND d.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND d.factory_code = #{factory} AND d.del_flag = '0') AS code_count, 1 AS parent_count FROM mom_mes.mes_task t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenant} AND t.factory_code = #{factory} AND t.del_flag = '0' AND NULLIF(TRIM(t.code), '') = #{q.taskCode}

mapper.sql:
SELECT b.*, CASE WHEN object_code IS NULL OR code_count != 1 THEN 'MISSING_OR_DUPLICATE_OBJECT_CODE' WHEN parent_count != 1 OR task_code IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_OR_DUPLICATE_PARENT' WHEN route_code IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_ROUTE_CODE' WHEN status IS NULL OR status NOT IN
('WAIT','UN_RECEIVE','RECEIVE','PRODUCT','PAUSE','FINISH','CLOSE') ('CREATE','ISSUE','DISPATCH','PRODUCT','FINISH','CLOSE')
THEN 'UNKNOWN_STATUS' WHEN status = 'FINISH' AND finish_time IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_FINISH_TIME' WHEN status = 'FINISH' AND finish_time > #{observed} THEN 'FUTURE_FINISH_TIME' WHEN status = 'FINISH' AND start_time IS NOT NULL AND finish_time < start_time THEN 'INVERTED_FINISH_TIME' WHEN status != 'FINISH' AND finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONTRADICTORY_FINISH_TIME' ELSE NULL END AS issue FROM () b

SELECT e.*, CASE WHEN issue IS NOT NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN status = 'CREATE' THEN 'DRAFT' WHEN status = 'CLOSE' THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN status = 'FINISH' AND finish_time <= planned_end_time THEN 'ON_TIME' WHEN status = 'FINISH' THEN 'LATE' ELSE 'OPEN' END AS category FROM () e WHERE planned_end_time >= #{q.startTime} AND planned_end_time < #{q.endTime} AND workshop_code = #{q.workshopCode}

CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) AS due_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'ON_TIME' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS on_time_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS late_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'OPEN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS open_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS closed_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS draft_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS unknown_count
mapper.select: SELECT AS group_code, FROM () c GROUP BY ORDER BY NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1001

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN planned_end_time IS NULL AND (issue IS NOT NULL OR (
status != 'CREATE' 1 = 1
AND status != 'CLOSE' )) AND workshop_code = #{q.workshopCode} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS missing_due_count, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN planned_end_time >= #{q.startTime} AND planned_end_time < #{q.endTime} AND workshop_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS VARCHAR) AS unattributed_due_count FROM () e
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR) FROM () c

SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS object_id, object_code, task_code, workshop_code, route_code, route_node_code, status, planned_end_time, finish_time, category, issue FROM () c
ORDER BY planned_end_time, id LIMIT 30 OFFSET #{offset}
